messages:
Ivy: Kicking off staged rollout v2026.04.12-hotfix -> 8% global, regions=[eu-west, na-east]. Change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://releases.redwood.ai/v2026.04.12-hotfix
DeployBot: deploy started id=hh-176666 target=8% regions=[eu-west,na-east]
Marco: monitoring embeddings 95p and model init times. eu-west showing a brief tail bump 100ms->220ms at ~90s. No 5xxs.
SRE-Oncall: noted. Pulling traces. Looks like a small set of nodes had high adapter init due to image unpack on scale-up. Recommend pausing eu-west and running prewarm.
Ivy: agree. Pause eu-west only: ``/deploy pause hh-176666 --region eu-west``
DeployBot: acknowledged: paused hh-176666 for region eu-west. rollout status: eu-west=0%, na-east=8% -> global~4%
ProductOps: confirmed na-east traffic remains on rc-stable. Any quick mitigation we can apply for eu-west?
SRE-Oncall: PREFETCH=1 + quick prewarm for eu-west should fix kv miss spike. Also add a short 95p tail alert.
Marco: I'll run prewarm and flip PREFETCH. Executing: ``infra/prewarm --region eu-west --model hotfix --prefetch 1``
DeployBot: prewarm job queued job=pw-176666-euw
Marco: prewarm finished. PREFETCH=1 applied. KV hit ratio improved 0.35->0.87.
Ivy: propose resume with conservative ramp 2%->8% over 6m. Anyone object?
ProductOps: no objections. Keep the rollback command handy.
DeployBot: resuming hh-176666: eu-west ramp=2%->8% over 6m; na-east remains 8%
SRE-Oncall: added temporary metric alert on eu-west kv-miss and embed-95p. Monitoring closely.
Marco: eu-west at 2%: 95p back to ~110ms.
Ivy: at 8% now. Leaving regional pin for 30m. Release notes updated: "hotfix: PREFETCH prewarm applied to eu-west to mitigate cold-start tail"
DeployBot: rollout complete hh-176666 -> 8% active. To rollback: ``/deploy rollback hh-176666``
SRE-Oncall: LGTM. Will escalate if any regressions. :thumbsup:
